name: Sis x Para -Sister Paradise-
source:
"Thanks to you, big brother, I can attend that school. You can do whatever you like to me."

With the onset of our parents' business trip, my sister and I have lived together.
Within the months and years that have passed in our parents' house, I've seen my sister become grown up.

(Sis, you've gotten this cute?)

It's been years since I've seen my sister's sleeping face.
My heart begins to flutter for that sleeping face, which faintly drifts with loveliness.

---

Tormented with the weight of the crime I've committed, I head to the kitchen where my sister, who always seems the same, is preparing breakfast.

"I guess you were tired. Not just from school, but from your part-time job and my own welfare."
"So until you can get a girlfriend, big brother, I'll give you myself instead."

From this time on, the story of the strange life of my sister and I begins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“多亏了哥哥，我才能上那所学校。你可以对我做任何你想做的事。”随着父母出差，我和妹妹开始了同居生活。在父母家度过的岁月中，我看着妹妹逐渐长大。（妹妹，你什么时候变得这么可爱了？）已经好几年没看到妹妹的睡颜了。那可爱得令人微微心动的睡颜让我的心开始悸动。——背负着犯下罪行的重压，我走向厨房，一如既往的妹妹正在准备早餐。“你累了吧。不只是学校，还有打工和照顾我。”“所以在你找到女朋友之前，哥哥，我会把自己给你。”从这一刻起，我和妹妹不可思议的生活故事开始了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
